channel.title: Japan, Plainly
channel.description: Straight answers about visiting and living in Japan, from Tokyo.

item.title: Onsen With Tattoos in Japan: How to Check, What to Ask, Where to Go
item.description: Can you go to an onsen in Japan with tattoos? How to read the tattoo rules in Japanese, what to ask staff, cover stickers, sentō and private baths.

item.title: Why Are Japanese Houses So Cold? How to Stay Warm for Less
item.description: Why Japanese homes are cold in winter, what each heater costs per hour, the air conditioner remote words in Japanese, and how to stop condensation and mould.

item.title: Tax-Free Shopping in Japan Since November 2026: How the New Refund System Works
item.description: Japan changed tax-free shopping on November 1, 2026. You now pay full price and get the tax back after customs checks your goods at departure. Here's how it works, step by step.

item.title: Lost Something in Japan? Trains, Taxis and Police Boxes
item.description: Lost something in Japan? What to do if you leave it on a train or in a taxi, how to report it at a koban, and what to do about cards and passports.

item.title: Japan Etiquette for First-Time Visitors: 10 Mistakes
item.description: Japan etiquette for first-time visitors: 10 things people get wrong, from ticket gates and trash to tipping, shoes, trains and visiting shrines.

item.title: How to Write Your Name in Japanese: Katakana vs Kanji
item.description: Learn how to write your name in Japanese: katakana for everyday use, kanji for gifts and art, how English sounds change, and which kanji to avoid.

item.title: How to Rent an Apartment in Japan as a Foreigner
item.description: How to rent an apartment in Japan as a foreigner: move-in costs like reikin and shikikin, guarantor companies, documents, screening and the contract.

item.title: Eating in Japan With a Food Allergy: What to Say
item.description: Eating in Japan with a food allergy: where fish, wheat and sesame hide, what to tell restaurant staff, how to read labels, and what to do in an emergency.
